verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs offer self-managed deployment: an official one-liner installs Elasticsearch and Kibana locally in Docker, and Elastic markets on-prem and private-cloud deployment. Community users confirm running it themselves on Kubernetes with the official operator or StatefulSets, and say the Elastic License lets them self-host. Missing for 10: production-grade self-managed installation docs (the quickstart covers only local development and testing), and clarity on which features stay free after the one-month trial license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Quickly set up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker for local development or testing, using this one-liner in the command line.
Elastic provides several self-managed and Elastic-managed options.
Deploy anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud
